entry.code_revision: COMPOSED CHECKPOINT, DECISION ADAPTER: ibm-granite/granite-switch-4.1-8b at fb4aa7877e13e5fe09ca328713dc1db72a3f93ce, identified by its card as revision 4.1.1. The composed checkpoint, not a base-plus-adapter recomposition or direct PEFT substitute, ran with the author Granite Switch vLLM plugin from generative-computing/granite-switch at 43ccd291a176507ae4ed5af293f8f2d947c0d451. A first-party dist-info marker registers the exact read-only plugin source without running author build scripts. The selected adapter is decision; Guardian and speech-to-text were not evaluated. Audio limit zero and skip-mm-profiling prevent the optional ASR route from loading; only plain string text reaches the backend. Composer and tutorial subtrees were excluded from the runtime mount. Source review and isolation do not constitute a full independent audit of every upstream/custom kernel. FIRST-PARTY WIRE SHIM: frozen System One requests are translated to local stock vLLM chat completions using the composed serving recipe: no system prompt, then a State: user turn and a ### DECISION user turn with the whole question, ordered option descriptions and Reply with exactly one option label. The author Decision Index recipe includes a fixed system prompt and is a different recipe. The shim reads raw first-generated-position label logprobs, not the sampled answer token. Explicit label reads are split into chunks of at most 128 IDs on the identical full prompt and joined by one stable global softmax; choice argmax, Noul P(true) and ordered score expectation use those probabilities. All actual prompt and generated tokens from every chunk are billed in native usage. No prompt truncation, permutation averaging, response repair or scored retry. MEASURED STACK: stock vLLM 0.30.0, Torch 2.13.0+cu130, CUDA 13.0, Transformers 5.17.0, tokenizers 0.23.3, Triton 3.7.1, BF16, max-num-seqs=1, chunked prefill=2048 and gpu-memory-utilization=0.90. Attention backend was explicitly TRITON_ATTN; FlashInfer sampling, all-reduce and autotune were disabled before sealed use to avoid the unavailable nvcc path. This declared backend selection can change roundoff/performance relative to automatic selection; no cross-backend numerical equivalence is claimed. The probability readout, labels, native attention formula, weights and dtype were not changed. A local dev-RPC memory observer reads peak CUDA allocator memory only; it does not alter model tensors or probabilities, and the shim cannot proxy that route. Runtime/source and tokenizer hashes were verified before protected staging. Upstream wheels were hash-locked; Debian libgomp1 12.2.0-14+deb12u1 and libnuma1 2.0.16-1 were recorded. Author/model execution occurred only on a disposable rented pod with offline flags, empty credentials, read-only mounts, restricted capabilities and network-none isolation.
